repair: Keep the strictly-past hinted objective and every real-round play unchanged. At the extra index use the final regularizer and the zero hint; the corrected terminal point minimizes the unhinted inclusive objective.
A repeated hint instead leaves h_T(u)−h_T(z). The varied regularizers also give a drift term over t<T. The unhinted terminal need not be unique when its announced curvature is zero.

The sharp bound is for every admissible supporting covector and comparator at specified nonnegative inclusive moduli. The divided Young bound needs positive specified moduli and uses their original induced dual norm.
qualification: Positive hinted curvature in a separately represented genuine norm does not make the unhinted curvature positive. The zero-hint terminal existence and sharp bound allow lambda=0. Young requires positive lambda. Preserve declared-zero curvature vs an actually flat unhinted terminal set, and distinguish ambient primal/dual norms from the hinted metric. Repeating the last hint has a residual term and cannot be canceled unconditionally.
carrier: The feasible set V ⊆ X in the finite-dimensional real normed ambient space E is nonempty and convex, and V is closed in E. X need not be closed. Regularizers are real on X, hints are real on V, and the ambient losses never take −∞. The supporting inequality is tested against all q in V; an ambient affine support restricts to V, with no converse on X asserted. The proof must derive finiteness at every feasible point used in the sums from inclusive-domain finiteness and ambient no-bottom losses.

import BanditRLProof.OnlineBTRLTerminal
import BanditRLProof.OnlineStrongConvexSupport
import Mathlib.Analysis.Seminorm

noncomputable section
open Set Finset
open BanditRL.OnlineConvex
namespace BanditRL.OnlineOptimistic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def hinted {X V : Set E} (incl : V ⊆ X) (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (v : V) : EReal :=
  (psi n ⟨v.val,incl v.property⟩ : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range n, loss i v.val + (hint n v : EReal)

abbrev inclusive {X V : Set E} (incl : V ⊆ X) (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (n : ℕ) (v : V) : EReal :=
  BanditRL.OnlineBTRL.sourceInclusive X psi loss n ⟨v.val,incl v.property⟩

def supports {V : Set E} (f : V → EReal) (p : V) (g : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : V, f p + (g (q.val-p.val) : EReal) ≤ f q

def restrictedStrong {V : Set E} (f : V → EReal) (N : Seminorm ℝ E) (l : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p q : V, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → ∀ hz : a • p.val + (1-a) • q.val ∈ V,
    f ⟨_,hz⟩ ≤ (a:EReal)*f p + ((1-a:ℝ):EReal)*f q -
      ((l/2*a*(1-a)*(N (p.val-q.val))^2 : ℝ) : EReal)

def hintedRegular {V : Set E} (A : ℕ → V → EReal) (T : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n < T, SourceClosed (A n) ∧ (∀ v : V, A n v < ⊤) ∧
    (∀ v : V, ∃ g : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, supports (A n) v g) ∧
    ∃ N : Seminorm ℝ E, (∀ v, N v = 0 → v = 0) ∧
      ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ restrictedStrong (A n) N μ

def inclusiveRegular {V : Set E} (G : ℕ → V → EReal) (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n < T, SourceClosed (G n) ∧ (∀ v : V, G n v < ⊤) ∧
    (∀ v : V, ∃ g : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, supports (G n) v g) ∧
    0 ≤ lam n ∧ restrictedStrong (G n) (normSeminorm ℝ E) (lam n)

def predicts {V : Set E} (A : ℕ → V → EReal) (T : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ n < T, ∀ q : V, A n (x n) ≤ A n q

def forecastError {V : Set E} (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (q : V) : EReal := loss n q.val - (hint n q : EReal)

def nextPlay {V : Set E} (T : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (z : V) (n : ℕ) : V :=
  if n+1=T then z else x (n+1)

def playedRegret {V : Set E} (T : ℕ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x : ℕ → V) (u : V) : ℝ :=
  (∑ n ∈ range T, (loss n (x n).val).toReal) - ∑ n ∈ range T, (loss n u.val).toReal

def regularizerTerms {X V : Set E} (incl : V ⊆ X) (T : ℕ) (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → V) (u : V) : ℝ :=
  let r (n : ℕ) (v : V) := psi n ⟨v.val,incl v.property⟩
  r (T-1) u - r 0 (x 0) + ∑ n ∈ range (T-1), (r n (x (n+1))-r (n+1) (x (n+1)))

def sharpTerms {V : Set E} (T : ℕ) (x : ℕ → V) (z : V)
    (g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (lam : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ range T, let v := (x n).val - (nextPlay T x z n).val;
                  g n v - lam n / 2 * ‖v‖^2

model_context.utf8_text:
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open Set Finset BanditRL.OnlineOptimistic
namespace BanditRL.OnlineOptimisticCanary

structure Inputs (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] where
  T : ℕ
  V : Set E
  psi : ℕ → ↥(Set.univ : Set E) → ℝ
  hint : ℕ → V → ℝ
  loss : ℕ → E → EReal
  lam : ℕ → ℝ
  x : ℕ → V
  g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ
  u : V

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
abbrev inc (m : Inputs E) : m.V ⊆ Set.univ := Set.subset_univ _
abbrev r (m : Inputs E) := playedRegret m.T m.loss m.x m.u
abbrev base (m : Inputs E) := regularizerTerms (inc m) m.T m.psi m.x m.u
abbrev s (m : Inputs E) (z : m.V) := base m + sharpTerms m.T m.x z m.g m.lam
abbrev y (m : Inputs E) := base m + ∑ n ∈ range m.T, ‖m.g n‖^2 / (2*m.lam n)
abbrev repeated (m : Inputs E) (z : m.V) := s m z + (m.hint (m.T-1) m.u - m.hint (m.T-1) z)
abbrev A (m : Inputs E) := hinted (inc m) m.psi m.loss m.hint
abbrev G (m : Inputs E) := inclusive (inc m) m.psi m.loss
abbrev allReal (v : ℝ) : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨v, Set.mem_univ _⟩
abbrev slope (a : ℝ) : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := a • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ

def repeatLast : Inputs ℝ where
  T := 1
  V := Set.univ
  psi := fun _ v => v.val^2/2
  hint := fun _ v => (v.val-1)^2/2
  loss := fun _ v => (((v-1)^2/2 : ℝ) : EReal)
  lam := fun _ => 2
  x := fun _ => allReal (1/2)
  g := fun _ => 0
  u := allReal (1/2)
abbrev repeatZ : repeatLast.V := allReal (1/2)
abbrev repeatZ' : repeatLast.V := allReal (2/3)

def driftingTwo : Inputs ℝ where
  T := 2
  V := Set.univ
  psi := fun n v => v.val^2/2 + (if n=0 then 0 else 2*v.val)
  hint := fun n v => if n=0 then 0 else -v.val
  loss := fun n v => ((if n=0 then v else 2*v : ℝ) : EReal)
  lam := fun _ => 1
  x := fun n => allReal (if n=0 then 0 else -2)
  g := fun n => slope (if n=0 then 1 else 3)
  u := allReal (-5)
abbrev driftZ : driftingTwo.V := allReal (-5)
abbrev term (m : Inputs E) (z : m.V) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  let v := (m.x n).val - (nextPlay m.T m.x z n).val
  m.g n v - m.lam n/2 * ‖v‖^2

abbrev Pair := ℝ × ℝ
def box : Set Pair := (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2)
def quad (w : Pair) : ℝ := (9*w.1^2-6*w.1*w.2+9*w.2^2)/8
def euc : Seminorm ℝ Pair :=
  (normSeminorm ℝ (WithLp 2 Pair)).comp (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ Pair).symm.toLinearMap
def boxFunctional : Pair →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ
def dualBox : Inputs Pair where
  T := 1
  V := box
  psi := fun _ v => quad v.val/2
  hint := fun _ _ => 0
  loss := fun _ w => if w ∈ box then ((w.1+w.2 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
  lam := fun _ => 1
  x := fun _ => ⟨(0,0), by norm_num [box, Set.mem_prod]⟩
  g := fun _ => boxFunctional
  u := ⟨(-4/3,-4/3), by norm_num [box, Set.mem_prod]⟩

def declaredZero : Inputs ℝ where
  T := 1
  V := Set.univ
  psi := fun _ v => v.val^2/2
  hint := fun _ _ => 0
  loss := fun _ v => (v : EReal)
  lam := fun _ => 0
  x := fun _ => allReal 0
  g := fun _ => slope 1
  u := allReal (-1)
def declaredOne : Inputs ℝ := { declaredZero with lam := fun _ => 1 }

def flatHalfLine : Inputs ℝ where
  T := 1
  V := Set.Ici 0
  psi := fun _ v => v.val^2/2
  hint := fun _ _ => 0
  loss := fun _ q => if 0 ≤ q then (((max (q-1) 0)^2/2-q^2/2 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
  lam := fun _ => 0
  x := fun _ => ⟨(0 : ℝ), by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ (0 : ℝ); exact le_rfl⟩
  g := fun _ => slope (-1)
  u := ⟨1, by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1; norm_num⟩
abbrev flatZero : flatHalfLine.V := ⟨0, by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0; exact le_rfl⟩
abbrev flatOne : flatHalfLine.V := ⟨1, by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1; norm_num⟩
abbrev flatMin (z : flatHalfLine.V) := ∀ q : flatHalfLine.V, G flatHalfLine 0 z ≤ G flatHalfLine 0 q

theorem optimistic_round_unique
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (incl : V ⊆ X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hclosedV : IsClosed V) (hconvV : Convex ℝ V)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hnobot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hA : hintedRegular (hinted incl psi loss hint) T) :
    ∀ n < T, ∃! p : V, ∀ q : V, hinted incl psi loss hint n p ≤ hinted incl psi loss hint n q

zero_hint_terminal_attained.utf8_text:
theorem zero_hint_terminal_attained
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (incl : V ⊆ X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hclosedV : IsClosed V) (hconvV : Convex ℝ V)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hnobot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hA : hintedRegular (hinted incl psi loss hint) T)
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hG : inclusiveRegular (inclusive incl psi loss) lam T)
    (x : ℕ → V) (hx : predicts (hinted incl psi loss hint) T x)
    (hsupp : ∀ n < T, ∃ g : E →L[ℝ] ℝ, supports (forecastError loss hint n) (x n) g) :
    ∃ z : V, ∀ q : V, inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) z ≤ inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) q

zero_hint_sharp_regret.utf8_text:
theorem zero_hint_sharp_regret
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (incl : V ⊆ X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hclosedV : IsClosed V) (hconvV : Convex ℝ V)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hnobot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hA : hintedRegular (hinted incl psi loss hint) T)
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hG : inclusiveRegular (inclusive incl psi loss) lam T)
    (x : ℕ → V) (hx : predicts (hinted incl psi loss hint) T x)
    (g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : ∀ n < T, supports (forecastError loss hint n) (x n) (g n))
    (z : V) (hz : ∀ q : V, inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) z ≤ inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) q) (u : V) :
    playedRegret T loss x u ≤ regularizerTerms incl T psi x u + sharpTerms T x z g lam

positive_modulus_young_regret.utf8_text:
theorem positive_modulus_young_regret
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (incl : V ⊆ X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hclosedV : IsClosed V) (hconvV : Convex ℝ V)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hnobot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hA : hintedRegular (hinted incl psi loss hint) T)
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hG : inclusiveRegular (inclusive incl psi loss) lam T)
    (x : ℕ → V) (hx : predicts (hinted incl psi loss hint) T x)
    (g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : ∀ n < T, supports (forecastError loss hint n) (x n) (g n))
    (hpos : ∀ n < T, 0 < lam n) (u : V) :
    playedRegret T loss x u ≤ regularizerTerms incl T psi x u +
      ∑ n ∈ range T, ‖g n‖^2 / (2*lam n)

repeated_hint_residual_regret.utf8_text:
theorem repeated_hint_residual_regret
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (incl : V ⊆ X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hclosedV : IsClosed V) (hconvV : Convex ℝ V)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hint : ℕ → V → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hnobot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hA : hintedRegular (hinted incl psi loss hint) T)
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hG : inclusiveRegular (inclusive incl psi loss) lam T)
    (x : ℕ → V) (hx : predicts (hinted incl psi loss hint) T x)
    (g : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : ∀ n < T, supports (forecastError loss hint n) (x n) (g n))
    (z : V) (hz : ∀ q : V,
      inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) z + (hint (T-1) z : EReal) ≤
      inclusive incl psi loss (T-1) q + (hint (T-1) q : EReal)) (u : V) :
    playedRegret T loss x u ≤ regularizerTerms incl T psi x u + sharpTerms T x z g lam + (hint (T-1) u - hint (T-1) z)

Repeat.utf8_text:
theorem repeat_last_residual :
    r repeatLast ≤ s repeatLast repeatZ ∧
    r repeatLast ≤ y repeatLast ∧
    r repeatLast ≤ repeated repeatLast repeatZ' ∧
    repeatZ ≠ repeatZ' ∧ r repeatLast = 0 ∧ s repeatLast repeatZ = 0 ∧ y repeatLast = 0 ∧
    s repeatLast repeatZ' = -1/36 ∧ repeatLast.hint 0 repeatLast.u - repeatLast.hint 0 repeatZ' = 5/72 ∧
    repeated repeatLast repeatZ' = 1/24 ∧ ¬r repeatLast ≤ s repeatLast repeatZ' ∧
    ¬r repeatLast ≤ s repeatLast repeatZ' - (repeatLast.hint 0 repeatLast.u - repeatLast.hint 0 repeatZ')

Drift.utf8_text:
theorem two_round_drift :
    r driftingTwo ≤ s driftingTwo driftZ ∧ r driftingTwo ≤ y driftingTwo ∧
    predicts (A driftingTwo) 2 driftingTwo.x ∧
    r driftingTwo = 11 ∧ driftingTwo.psi 1 (allReal (-5)) - driftingTwo.psi 0 (allReal 0) = 5/2 ∧
    driftingTwo.psi 0 (allReal (-2)) - driftingTwo.psi 1 (allReal (-2)) = 4 ∧
    term driftingTwo driftZ 0 = 0 ∧ term driftingTwo driftZ 1 = 9/2 ∧
    s driftingTwo driftZ = 11 ∧ y driftingTwo = 23/2 ∧ ¬r driftingTwo ≤ s driftingTwo driftZ - 4

Box.utf8_text:
theorem dual_box_norms :
    r dualBox ≤ s dualBox dualBox.u ∧ r dualBox ≤ y dualBox ∧
    (∀ w, euc w = 0 → w = 0) ∧ restrictedStrong (A dualBox 0) euc (3/4) ∧
    restrictedStrong (G dualBox 0) (normSeminorm ℝ Pair) 1 ∧
    (∀ w : Pair, (euc w)^2 = w.1^2+w.2^2) ∧ euc (1,1) ≠ ‖((1,1) : Pair)‖ ∧
    ‖boxFunctional‖ = 2 ∧ boxFunctional (1,1) = 2 ∧
    dualBox.loss 0 (3,0) = ⊤ ∧ supports (forecastError dualBox.loss dualBox.hint 0) (dualBox.x 0) boxFunctional ∧
    r dualBox = 8/3 ∧ s dualBox dualBox.u = 28/9 ∧ y dualBox = 10/3 ∧
    base dualBox + (euc (1,1))^2/2 = 7/3 ∧ ¬r dualBox ≤ base dualBox + (euc (1,1))^2/2

Zero.utf8_text:
theorem announced_zero_and_positive_young :
    r declaredZero ≤ s declaredZero declaredZero.u ∧ r declaredOne ≤ y declaredOne ∧
    declaredZero.lam 0 = 0 ∧ declaredOne.lam 0 = 1 ∧
    r declaredZero = 1 ∧ s declaredZero declaredZero.u = 3/2 ∧
    y declaredZero = 1/2 ∧ ¬r declaredZero ≤ y declaredZero ∧ y declaredOne = 1

Flat.utf8_text:
theorem flat_terminal_minimizers :
    (∀ n < flatHalfLine.T, ∃! p : flatHalfLine.V, ∀ q : flatHalfLine.V, A flatHalfLine n p ≤ A flatHalfLine n q) ∧
    (∃ z : flatHalfLine.V, flatMin z) ∧
    (∀ z : flatHalfLine.V, z.val ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → r flatHalfLine ≤ s flatHalfLine z) ∧
    (∀ z : flatHalfLine.V, flatMin z ↔ z.val ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) ∧
    flatMin flatZero ∧ flatMin flatOne ∧ flatZero ≠ flatOne ∧
    (∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ¬restrictedStrong (G flatHalfLine 0) (normSeminorm ℝ ℝ) μ) ∧
    flatHalfLine.loss 0 (-1) = ⊤ ∧ r flatHalfLine = 1/2 ∧
    (∀ z : flatHalfLine.V, z.val ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → s flatHalfLine z = 1/2+z.val)

required_obligations: Each displayed public bound occupies the indicated conjunction slot, including the universal z in Flat. Fully instantiate its original model-specific premises without adding assumptions to these closed headers. Reconstruct all 12 actual applications and data/proof slots from proof terms after separate seal.

Box: derive hinted regularity with exactly euc and 3/4, not just another legal modulus/norm; derive inclusive display sup curvature with exactly 1. With actual subgradient g=(1,1), operator norm upper bound from |a+b|<=2 max(|a|,|b|) and lower at (1,1).

Flat: prove convexity and tangent support of G on the ray from concrete formula; prove support of forecast error at 0 with slope -1. Obtain universal third slot from C using independently proved argmin characterization. Exclude positive curvature using endpoints 0,1 and midpoint, show A selects 0 via concrete quadratic.

Repeat: show unhinted minimizer 1/2 and repeated minimizer 2/3 from quadratic on all R, and two distinct required parent operands. Drift: derive actual strict-past predictions and terminal minimizer from quadratics.

Source-scope: five tests are models of proposed corrected interfaces. The zero-denominator expression tests dropping D positivity only; no D call at λ=0. No original row adjudication from these canaries.
